name: sdlc
description: You drive a loose loop, Frame, Explore, Plan, Build, Verify, Review, and a machine decides when it is done: house rules at session start that have the agent grill you one question at a time when a change is vague and look where gaps hide; a retro skill that, once a non-trivial change is finished, has a fresh agent read the session and tells you, with cases from it, what to do next time to get better output; agents that review a design, review a diff, verify each finding and run non-coding tasks in parallel; plus hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, a pull request size cap, gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers or switch a checker off, and a reminder to run the retro once a branch with more than a few lines of code is merged or opened as a pull request.
